canon_levels: Phoenixmon, HerculesKabuterimon, MetalEtemon, Machinedramon, Analogman and Jijimon are Megas with NEW DIGIMON on. No Champion-to-Mega exceptions: Phoenixmon follows fire/air Ultimates and HerculesKabuterimon follows forest/insect Ultimates. Explicit off JSON retains the original levels and routes with NEW DIGIMON off. Red Ruby, Beetlepearl and Metalbanana require an Ultimate when their target is Mega. Whamon (24) is Ultimate; story Whamon (146) is unchanged.
specialty_reason: Kurisarimon follows the identity sheet. Original battle specialties are preserved; IceLeomon additionally has Ice in its third slot. Original-disc links are exempt from shared-specialty checks.
